description: ADO-RESYNC, the unexplained UnderlyingValue: a client batch-optimistic recordset of K IDs 1 to 4. Round A (clean row ID 1): connection B sets L to 701, 8 s, then Value/OriginalValue/UnderlyingValue before and after Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncUnderlyingValues) and after Resync(adAffectCurrent, adResyncUnderlyingValues). Round B repeats it with L 702 and no pause. Round C (control, pending edit on row ID 2: L put to 555, then B sets L to 703): the same channels before and after Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncUnderlyingValues). Recordset.Status is read at each point. Asks when ADO refreshes UnderlyingValue and whether the 777 versus 888 answer repeats.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
